import csv, os, statistics
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

input_path = '/work/inputs/art_ad30ef00c5dc4c6a97a86373f5d8e538/numbers.csv'
with open(input_path, newline='') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    values = []
    for row in reader:
        values.append(float(row['value']))

count = len(values)
total = sum(values)
mean = statistics.mean(values) if values else float('nan')

os.makedirs('/work/outputs', exist_ok=True)
with open('/work/outputs/summary.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['count','sum','mean'])
    writer.writerow([count, total, mean])

# print content and stats for debugging
with open(input_path, newline='') as f:
    print('CSV content:', repr(f.read()))
print('count:', count)
print('sum:', total)
print('mean:', mean)

plt.figure(figsize=(400/100, 300/100), dpi=100)
plt.bar(range(len(values)), values)
plt.title('value')
plt.xlabel('row')
plt.ylabel('value')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/work/outputs/chart.png')
plt.close()
print('outputs:', os.listdir('/work/outputs'))
